parsed.post: Keep! Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 with DEPTH 6 and all shards dropped val_bpb from 0.8635 to 0.8538. More optimizer steps are paying off. Next, I'll test increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to see if the smaller batch size allows for a higher learning rate.
parsed.description: Reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps, and slightly increase MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to capitalize on the smaller batch stability.
